comments.author: @AmazingDiscoveriesTopUS
comments.text: If you could experience only one place in Indonesia- Bli Komodo, Mount Bromo, Kawah Ijen or Raja Ampat- Which would you choose?

replies.author: @BestTravelDocumentary4k
replies.text: That is a tough choice! Raja Ampat’s underwater world is unmatched, but Bromo’s volcanic landscapes are incredible too. 🏝️🌋 Which one of these four is at the very top of your personal bucket list?"

comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: Watching that fresh nutmeg being cracked open to reveal the bright red center is so satisfying! Who would have thought that centuries ago, the Dutch literally traded the entire island of Manhattan just to get their hands on a tiny Indonesian island that grew this spice. Such a crazy piece of history! 🤯🇮🇩 Did anyone know about this before watching?

replies.author: @BestTravelDocumentary4k
replies.text: The Treaty of Breda and the story of Run Island is truly one of the most unbelievable twists in history! 🇲🇨 Manhattan for nutmeg seems wild today. What other historic spice route fact surprised you the most?"
